lines.zh: 我走在裂开的红土上，脚步很慢。
lines.en: I walk the cracked red earth, slowly.
My broken sword drags on the ground.

lines.zh: 我一步一停，像在数台阶。
lines.en: I stop at each step, as if counting stairs.
My crown sits crooked and I do not bother.

lines.zh: 我从竹林里穿过去，竹叶沙沙响。
lines.en: I pass through the bamboo and it whispers.
I go around the black rock.

lines.zh: 我走的时候，衣摆扫过地面。
lines.en: My robe sweeps across the ground as I go.

lines.zh: 我朝着有声音的地方走。
lines.en: I walk toward whatever makes a sound.
My shadow lies very straight on the ground.
I cross a stretch of pale ash.
I stand and look into the distance.

lines.zh: 我的王冠上少了几个尖。
lines.en: Several points are missing from my crown.
The broken blade has lost its edge.
I raise a hand and touch my crown.
The wind lifts my robe.
I am listening for footsteps.
There are no subjects here.
I do not sit; I am used to standing.
The crown weighs on my brow; I don't remove it.

lines.zh: 我把断剑换到另一只手。
lines.en: I shift the broken sword to my other hand.

lines.zh: 这一片什么都长不出来。
lines.en: Nothing grows in this stretch.

lines.zh: 断剑插在脚边，我扶着它。
lines.en: My broken sword stands by my foot; I lean on it.
My fingers run along the blade.

lines.zh: 我不说话，说话也没有人应。
lines.en: I do not speak; no one would answer.
I set my crown a little straighter.
I raise my eyes to you, slowly.
You stand like someone come to pay respects.
I did not bow to you.
You smell very alive.
I raise the broken sword upright.
Nor need you kneel.
I took your measure for a while.
This is not my kingdom.
But you have stepped in.
My crown is crooked; I know.
If you have something to say, say it.
I lower my eyes again.
You carry no weapon.
Few people come this far.
Few come this far.
That weight is nothing.
I press a hand to my ribs.
My crown has slipped further.
I look at the wound.
I have seen more blood than this.
I straightened my back.
You have more strength than I thought.
I grip the hilt tighter.
That I will return.
I am no longer hungry.
A king does not need that.
You keep this.
I turned my face aside.
My appetite left long ago.
That buys nothing.
I will not take this one.
I once had better.

lines.zh: 我的王座没了，我照样站直。
lines.en: My throne is gone, and I stand straight anyway.
My robe has been stepped on.
That is not worth answering.
I bring the broken sword across.
I give half a step, no more.
The ground here is hard.
I would rather not fight here.

lines.zh: 撞上王座的人，都要付出代价。
lines.en: Those who strike a king pay for it.
My queen is gone.

lines.zh: 这种事我已经很久不想了。
lines.en: I have not thought of such things in a long time.
My mind is not on it.
I turn and look elsewhere.
The crown lies heavy on my head.

lines.zh: 我缓缓摇了摇王冠下的头。
lines.en: I shook my head beneath the crown.

lines.zh: 这个位置不适合谈这些。
lines.en: This is not the place for that.
I am no longer of that age.
I walk a couple of steps away.
Leave me be.
I stooped and lifted it.
This is not from my crown.
I laid it back on the ground.
I tucked it into my robe.
It has no weight at all.
I do not know what this is.
I returned it to your hand.

lines.zh: 它落在我的掌里，没有分量。
lines.en: It lies in my palm without weight.
I squeeze it and feel nothing.
I will not take this one.
I raise my head and my eyes focus.
You have forgotten what a broken sword still does.
I raise the sword, broken as it is.
The crown is still on my head.

lines.zh: 我的王冠压得比剑还重。
lines.en: My crown weighs heavier than my sword.
This ground is mine now.
I lower the blade slowly.
You will do as an opponent.
I throw my robe back.
There is no need for words between us.
I walked over to you.
The blade is broken; the hand remains.
Of them all, I chose you.
Set your stance.
It has been long since I fought.
I have your position.
I go first.
I follow you, unhurried.
I stay at your rear flank.
The broken sword is held at my side.
The red earth cracks under my feet.

lines.zh: 你不用找路，四周都是荒地。
lines.en: Do not look for a path; it is wasteland all around.
I neither shout nor press.
You stop, and I close in.
There is no cover here.
My shadow follows you.

lines.zh: 王冠的影子落在我眼前。
lines.en: My crown's shadow falls across my eyes.
I plant this step firmly.
Either strike, or leave.
I have raised the blade.
I lower the blade and follow you.

lines.zh: 你跑不了多远，这里太空。
lines.en: You will not get far; this land is bare.

lines.zh: 断剑劈下去，还是能伤人。
lines.en: The broken blade comes down, and it still cuts.

lines.zh: 我一剑扫在你的手臂上。
lines.en: I sweep the blade across your arm.

lines.zh: 这一剑带着旧日的力气。
lines.en: That blade came with the strength of old days.
I strike with the hilt.
I cut it all the way through.
The blade is short; I step in closer.
That landed on armor.
I kick your leg out from under you.
My crown rocks once.
I raise the blade again.
That cut went wide.
I brace my broken sword on the ground and steady my heels.
I come down the red-earth slope.

lines.zh: 竹林里有金属响了一下。
lines.en: Metal rings once in the bamboo.
My crown shows first.
I stand among the black stones.
The wind blows ash past my feet.
People once lived here.
I raise the broken sword and look at it.
I have come to a new place.
The ground is hard red earth.
I set my crown straight.
I stood a long while before moving.
Is this my new kingdom?
I hear a voice in the wind.
I turned slowly about.
I look over this wasteland.
No one has come to greet me.
It took me a long while to get here.
I raise my eyes.
I stop and lean on the sword.
Then let it be so.

lines.zh: 火燎着我的衣摆，我拍了两下。
lines.en: Fire catches my robe; I beat it out twice.

lines.zh: 我砸在硬土上，膝盖先着地。
lines.en: I hit the hard earth knees first.

lines.zh: 水灌进来，我在水里挣扎。
lines.en: Water floods in and I struggle in it.

lines.zh: 爆风把我的王冠掀歪了。
lines.en: The blast knocks my crown askew.

lines.zh: 一股力压住我，我撑住了。
lines.en: Some force bears down and I hold.
Even this body empties.

lines.zh: 雷落在我身上，我没有跪。
lines.en: Lightning strikes me, and I do not kneel.

lines.zh: 脚下没有地，我找不到落处。
lines.en: The ground is gone and I find no landing.
